description: Abstract class defining cryptographic client interface for AWS SDK, including supported ciphers, key wraps, security profiles, and abstract methods for encryption and decryption streams.

classes.name: AbstractCryptoClientV2
classes.description: Defines an abstract cryptographic client with support for specific cipher algorithms, key wrapping, security profiles, and methods for encryption and decryption streams.

methods.name: isSupportedCipher
methods.description: Checks if a given cipher name is supported for encryption.

methods.name: getCipherOpenSslName
methods.description: Abstract method to get the OpenSSL cipher name based on cipher name and key size.

methods.name: buildCipherMethod
methods.description: Abstract method to construct a CipherMethod object for encryption/decryption.

methods.name: getCipherFromAesName
methods.description: Abstract method to get the OpenSSL cipher name from an AES name.

methods.name: encrypt
methods.description: Abstract method to create an encryption stream with given plaintext, options, provider, and envelope.

methods.name: decrypt
methods.description: Abstract method to create a decryption stream with given ciphertext, provider, envelope, and options.
